page.title: Agent settings · Agent J
page.description: Settings for the Agent on this computer: phone remotes, pairing, its name.
hero.unnamed: This Agent has no name yet
hero.note: This page only opens on this computer (its address is 127.0.0.1). A new phone remote can only be approved here, or by running `agentj pair` in a terminal.
conn.title: Connection
conn.relay_na: Waits until the agentj program runs
conn.company_none: Not in an Agent J account. Changes stay on this computer
conn.company_hidden: In an Agent J account (name hidden while pairing)
conn.hint: To add a phone remote, the agentj program has to be running. If it isn't, run `agentj service install` in a terminal. Without it you can still rename the Agent and unlink remotes here.
devices.title: Phone remotes
devices.empty: No phone remotes yet. Pair a phone with “Add a phone remote” below.
devices.confirm_unbind: Unlink “{name}”? It disconnects right away and would need to scan a new code to come back.
pair.title: Add a phone remote
pair.intro: Press the button and a QR code shows up here. Scan it with your phone's camera; the phone then shows a 6-digit code, which you type in here.
pair.need_program: The agentj program isn't running, so pairing is off for now.
pair.scan: Scan this QR code with your phone's camera. {left}; it works once.
pair.link_warn: This link is the pairing key. Open it only on your own phone and never send it to anyone else.
pair.pending_lead: A device has connected. It calls itself “{name}”.
pair.untrusted: The device picked that name itself — don't rely on it.
pair.code_where: The 6-digit code appears only on the phone; this page never shows it. {n} s left.
pair.code_label: Look at the phone and type the 6-digit code it shows
pair.pass_hint: Only you know it. Set it in a terminal with `agentj passphrase set`.
pair.pass_unset: No approval passphrase yet. Run `agentj passphrase set` in a terminal on this computer first — approving needs it.
pair.pass_wrong: Wrong approval passphrase. {n} more wrong tries and it locks for a while. The device is still waiting — try again.
pair.full_lead: A new device is waiting for approval. It calls itself “{name}”.
pair.full_warn: All {limit} phone remote slots are taken. Unlink one to make room. The one you unlink disconnects right away and would need to pair again.
pair.full_deny: Keep them all, decline the new device
pair.confirm_unbind: Unlink “{name}” to make room for the new device? It disconnects right away.
pair.unbound_next: Unlinked “{name}”. Now type the 6-digit code shown on the phone.
pair.unbind_failed: Couldn't unlink it (it may already be gone).
pair.approved: Approved “{name}”. It is now a phone remote for this host.
pair.evict_note: All 5 phone remote slots on this host are taken. Approving unlinks the remote unused the longest: “{name}” (paired {when}, offline now). To keep it, deny, then unlink another one in the list below first.
pair.evict_note_online: All 5 phone remote slots on this host are taken and all are online. Approving unlinks the remote unused the longest: “{name}” (paired {when}); it disconnects right away. To keep it, deny, then unlink another one in the list below first.
pair.replaces_note: This is the same browser that paired before (it lost its pairing data). Approving replaces its old entry “{name}” (paired {when}) instead of taking another slot.
pair.replaced_done: Replaced the same browser’s old entry: “{name}” (paired {when}).
pair.expired: The QR code expired (it lasts 5 minutes). Start again to get a new one.
deny.code_mismatch: The 6-digit code didn't match, so the device was declined.
deny.timeout: Nobody confirmed within 120 seconds, so the device was declined.
deny.bad_handshake: The phone and this computer couldn't set up an encrypted connection, so the device was declined.
deny.hs_timeout: The phone didn't finish connecting, so it was declined.
deny.device_limit: All 5 phone remote slots are taken, so nothing was approved. Unlink one first.
deny.no_pending_device: No device is waiting for approval.
deny.replaced: Another pairing took over (`agentj pair` in a terminal, or another settings page).
deny.relay_down: Can't reach the relay server right now. Try again in a moment.
deny.pass_locked: Too many wrong approval passphrases — it's locked for a while. Try again later.
deny.pass_not_set: No approval passphrase yet. Run `agentj passphrase set` in a terminal on this computer first.
err.serve_not_running: The agentj program isn't running. Run `agentj service install` in a terminal, then add the phone remote.
err.serve_busy: The agentj program isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
err.relay_down: Can't reach the relay server (the agentj program is reconnecting). Try again in a moment.
err.unbind_first: All slots are taken. Unlink a phone remote first.
err.no_pending_device: No device is waiting for approval.
err.unknown_device: That device isn't on the list (it may already be unlinked).
err.passphrase_required: The approval passphrase is needed too.
err.generic: That didn't work. Reload the page and try again.
name.title: The Agent's name
name.intro: It's the name you'll use every day when you talk to this Agent. If this computer is in an Agent J account, the name changes on the account dashboard first (names are unique within an account) and only then here.
name.label: New name
name.err.bad_name: That name won't work: 1–32 characters, no line breaks or invisible characters (spaces at the ends are trimmed, runs of spaces become one).
name.err.name_taken: This account already has an Agent with that name.
name.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach the account dashboard, so the name didn't change.
name.err.not_bound: The account dashboard has already taken this computer out of the account, so the name didn't change. Run `agentj unlink` in a terminal to clear that record; after that you can rename it here only.
name.err.rate_limited: Too many renames (at most 20 an hour). The name didn't change — try again later.
name.err.failed: The account dashboard turned this rename down, so the name didn't change.
remote.title: Unlinking from the account dashboard
remote.label: Allow unlinking this computer's phone remotes from the account dashboard
remote.on: On: the account owner can unlink this computer's phone remotes from the account dashboard, up to 3 an hour. It can only remove, never add.
remote.off: Off: this computer refuses every unlink request from the account dashboard. Unlink here instead, or with `agentj revoke` in a terminal.
tips.title: Good to know
tips.one: One person per Agent works best. The 5 phone remotes are meant for the same person's phone, tablet and computer. When several people steer one Agent at once, they get in each other's way.
tips.seat: One Agent is one paid seat, and it runs on one computer or server. Its name is just a label — like naming a pet, anything goes.
tips.qr: Pairing QR codes and links only ever appear on this computer. If the account dashboard, an email or a support person sends you a QR code, don't scan it.
session.logged_out: You're not signed in, or the session has ended. Run `agentj admin` in a terminal on this computer (or press Enter in its terminal) to get a fresh link.
session.link_used: This link was already used or has expired. Press Enter in the terminal running `agentj admin` to get a fresh one.
session.bye: Signed out. To come back, press Enter in the terminal running `agentj admin` for a fresh link.
session.unreachable: Can't reach the Agent settings page right now (`agentj admin` may have stopped).
footer.tagline: Your AI assistant works on your computer. You run it from your phone.
pair.pre_set: No approval passphrase yet, so pairing can't start. Run `agentj passphrase set` in a terminal on this computer yourself (not through an agent); this page updates once it's set.
pair.pre_set_offline: This computer is bound to your account but isn't connected to the relay yet, so the account page can't approve right now. Wait until it connects, or set an approval passphrase with `agentj passphrase set`.
pair.pre_set_off: This computer is bound to your account, but adding remotes from the account page is off. Turn it on with `agentj remote-pair on`, or set an approval passphrase with `agentj passphrase set`.
pair.pre_account: This computer is bound to your account: on the account page, choose Add a remote on this computer's seat card, confirm once with your passkey and scan. No approval passphrase needed. You can also scan here, then approve the waiting phone on the same seat card.
pair.pre_account_pass: This computer is bound to your account: approve with your passkey from Add a remote on the account page's seat card, or scan here and type the 6-digit code and your approval passphrase.
pair.pending_account: Approve this phone on this computer's seat card on the account page (confirm with your passkey); this page updates once it's approved. Don't want it? Click Deny.
err.passphrase_not_set: No approval passphrase yet: run `agentj passphrase set` in a terminal on this computer, or bind an account and add the remote from the account page.
